original_text: Kifungu cha nomino kinatumia mpangilio wa sentensi ya taarifa (@@INLINE_CODE_EA04A02E_0000@@) badala ya mpangilio wa swali (@@INLINE_CODE_8DDDCA72_0001@@).
translated_text: Nominalni deo koristi redosled deklarativne rečenice (@@INLINE_CODE_EA04A02E_0000@@) umesto redosleda interrogativne rečenice (@@INLINE_CODE_8DDDCA72_0001@@).
